question: Which flowers are declared equal in value to karavira?
premises: Karavira is the standard of comparison.
Jati is said to be equal to karavira.
Vijaya-patali is also said to be equal to karavira.
inference: Jati and vijaya-patali should be known as equal to karavira.
plain_english: Jati and vijaya-patali should be known as equal to karavira.
